findings.message: Text contrast is 1.5:1; normal text needs at least 4.5:1.
findings.suggestion: Darken the text colour or lighten the background until the ratio meets the minimum.

findings.message: Form control (text field) has no label; a screen reader cannot say what it is for. A hint or placeholder does not count as a label.
findings.suggestion: Provide InputDecoration(labelText: …) for fields, or wrap the control in Semantics(label: …) and associate it with its caption.
findings.codeExample:
// Before — a hint is not a label
TextField(controller: _email,
    decoration: InputDecoration(hintText: 'you@example.com'))

// After — add a real label
TextField(controller: _email,
    decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: 'Email',
        hintText: 'you@example.com'))

findings.message: Image has no text alternative; a screen reader cannot describe it.
findings.suggestion: Provide Image(…, semanticLabel: '…'), or wrap a purely decorative image in ExcludeSemantics.

findings.message: Interactive element has no accessible name; a screen reader announces only its role.
findings.suggestion: Wrap it in Semantics(label: '…', button: true, child: …) or use IconButton(tooltip: …).
